skill.name: diagram-design
skill.usageExample: 帮我画一张微服务架构图：客户端经网关到四个服务，服务共享一个数据库和缓存，做成适合放进技术文档的编辑风格，最后导出一张高清 PNG。

description.zh: 按编辑级设计规范生成 39 种图表：架构图、流程图、时序图、状态机、ER 模型、甘特图、桑基图、鱼骨图、Wardley 地图等，输出自包含 HTML/SVG/PNG。支持重绘 draw.io 与 Mermaid 源图、从网站提取品牌色定制皮肤，内置复杂度预算与连线规则保证可读性。
description.en: Create branded architecture, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER, timeline, Gantt, Sankey, Wardley map and 30+ other diagram types as standalone HTML/SVG/PNG, following an opinionated editorial design system. Redraw .drawio or Mermaid sources; onboard brand tokens from a website.
